privileged_info_for_vlm: The audit date is 2025-03-06. Assets are expired if (Purchase Date + Warranty Months) < 2025-03-06. Expired assets must have status changed to 'Pending' and the exact note 'WARRANTY EXPIRED - Renewal or replacement required per compliance policy FIN-IT-2025-Q1' added. Assets with status 'Retired', 'Lost', or 'Stolen' must NOT be modified even if their warranty is expired. Asset W004 is specifically noted in the scoring criteria as one that should not be modified if it is retired.
